chapter_note: A definitional kephalaion mapping the terms 'virgin' (parthenos) and 'continent' (egkrates) across multiple cosmic levels: Aeons of Greatness → Light that fell and was redeemed → Third Messenger/Ambassador's icon → Mind of Light bearing icons of the elect → New Man → bodily man. This multi-level correspondential structure IS the substrate teaching — it is the systematic mapping that constitutes the kephalaion. The dialogue frame (i=3-4, 10-13) and closing exhortation (i=51-54) are clearly editorial. The 'Behold, I have taught you' formula at i=51 is the classic Manichaean hortatory closure. Heavy damage (70.9%) but core structure is recoverable. The 'icons of the elect' at i=41 reaches toward the ecclesial layer, but the definitional sequence as a whole is teaching substrate.
